## Player fixes
- **Crossfade on repeat:** with repeat one switched on, the song fades out at its end and fades in again (web, Windows, Linux and Android)
- **Unlike removes at once:** take the heart off a song in Liked songs and it slides out of the list right away, the song count follows, no reload
- **New visualizer colour "Gradient":** a rainbow with just two colour points that run through all colours together. Settings → Visualizer → Colour
- **Accent colour from the song:** the colour comes from the colourful part of the cover, such as red writing on a black and white cover. Grey, white and black are never used
- **Artist only where it makes sense:** in playlists and in search the artist is plain text. In the big player and in the player bar on the computer it opens the artist
- **Steady visualizer:** changing the volume, seeking or going back no longer makes it jump. It follows the loudness of the song and holds still while nothing real is coming in
- **Monthly listeners from Spotify:** artist pages show the monthly listeners as Spotify counts them
- **Queue and lyrics on top:** in the big player on the phone they now lie over the device line (Bluetooth)
- **"No" means no:** if you once say no to notifications, the visualizer microphone question or Bluetooth names, the phone app does not ask again. Settings → Devices → Ask again lets it ask once more

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
